subject: infra.energy
name: National policy linking digital infrastructure to energy supply
what_would_settle_it: A national policy or programme document connecting grid rehabilitation or generation capacity to digital-infrastructure planning.

subject: infra.capacity
name: Compute or high-performance computing capacity
what_would_settle_it: A data-centre, cloud or high-performance computing specification, or a hosting contract for a public system beyond the two named data centres.

subject: data.satellite
name: Earth-observation or satellite-data programme
what_would_settle_it: A national earth-observation or geospatial-data programme document, or an agency mandate covering satellite data.

subject: digital.rural
name: Dedicated rural digital-service programme
what_would_settle_it: A programme document or budget line for rural digital-service delivery, distinct from the 4G tower-expansion programme.

subject: gov.standards
name: National technical standards or interoperability framework
what_would_settle_it: A national interoperability framework, technical standard or e-government architecture document.

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal
what_would_settle_it: A public-sector open-data portal or policy document.

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union digital cooperation with Sudan
what_would_settle_it: Any EU or European Investment Bank digital financing, programme or memorandum covering Sudan.

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Start-up or innovation-sector support programme
what_would_settle_it: A start-up statute, incubator programme or innovation-fund document.

subject: geopol.usa
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: United States digital-sector engagement with Sudan
what_would_settle_it: Any US government or agency digital-sector financing, programme or memorandum covering Sudan, distinct from the commercial Isali/National Workers Bank rail.

subject: geopol.china
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Chinese digital investment in Sudan
what_would_settle_it: Any Chinese financing, contract or memorandum covering Sudanese digital infrastructure.

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Indian digital-sector engagement with Sudan
what_would_settle_it: Any Indian government or vendor financing, contract or memorandum covering Sudanese digital infrastructure.

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital-literacy programme or measurement
what_would_settle_it: A digital-literacy programme document, or a published measurement of digital literacy.

subject: capacity.research
name: Applied digital-research programme
what_would_settle_it: A university, agency or donor-funded applied digital-research programme document.
